root_text:
HMPV Symptoms:

Mild: Runny nose, cough, fever, fatigue.

Severe: Wheezing, shortness of breath, pneumonia.
High risk: Infants, elderly, immunocompromised. Seek care if severe! #Health #HMPV https://t.co/1Ec9175GsP
